about.title: About Us
about.founded: MediFind was founded by a group of students from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and University of Economics Ho Chi Minh city (UEH)
about.description: MediFind uses artificial intelligence to identify the medicines in a photo of a prescription or a medicine package, then explains how to take them safely. Pharmacists and physicians use it to verify what they are dispensing; patients and families use it to understand what they have been given.
about.features: The app adds reminders so no dose is missed, a chat assistant for follow-up questions, and a map of nearby pharmacies — so the same information is available at the counter and at home.
about.first_in_vietnam: MediFind is the first application in Vietnam that allows users to recognize prescriptions through images and digital letters.

architecture.description: MediFind's central architecture is based on two stages: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Natural Language Processing (NLP). By combining VietOCR and spaCy, and after a careful fine-tuning process, we have achieved a high degree of accuracy in identifying the names of medicines and antibiotics.

legal.title: Disclaimer & Privacy
legal.disclaimer_short: MediFind provides medicine information, not medical advice. Always consult a physician or pharmacist before changing how you take a prescription.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
items: MediFind provides general information about medicines. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it does not create a doctor–patient relationship.
MediFind does not replace a physician, pharmacist, or any other qualified healthcare professional. Always consult one before starting, stopping, or changing a medication.

Prescription recognition relies on optical character recognition and language models. These can misread handwriting, misidentify a drug name, or return an incorrect dosage. Always verify against the physical prescription and the packaging.
Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read here or in the app.
In an emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately. Do not rely on MediFind.

The competition results, partner clinics, and research described on this site relate to the project's development. They are not a clinical validation of the product and are not a regulatory approval of any kind.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This website is a portfolio site. It is deliberately minimal about data.
items: No analytics. No tracking pixels, no third-party scripts, no advertising networks.
No accounts, no forms, and no personal data is collected or transmitted by this website.

One cookie is set: medifind-language. It stores your language preference (en or vi) so the site opens in the same language next time. It expires after one year and contains nothing else. Clearing it simply resets language detection.
Fonts are self-hosted and served from this domain, so no request is made to a third-party font provider.
This site is hosted by a third-party provider, which may keep standard server access logs. Those are outside our control and are not used by us.

The MediFind mobile application is in a closed beta and is not publicly available. It has its own separate privacy policy covering the data it processes, provided to testers directly. This notice covers this website only.
